description:
Knock is agent-first customer engagement infrastructure for your product, marketing, and transactional messaging. One platform to manage all your messaging across email, SMS, push, chat, and in-app.

Inspect workflows and manage notifications, directly in ChatGPT and Codex.

defaultPrompt: Create a workflow called onboarding-flow that sends a welcome email when a user signs up, then a follow-up email two days later.
Help set up an in-app notification feed for my website and app.
What percentage of users clicked the main CTA on the first email in our "welcome" broadcast?
